terra.problem: The passage does not say Jehoshaphat fought right next to Ahab.
The explanation presents the robes as the reason the commanders mistake Jehoshaphat for the king of Israel. The text does not say what caused their mistake.
The closing line implies that the robes caused the commanders' mistake. The passage does not give the reason.
The passage says the commanders turned back, not that Jehoshaphat no longer interested them.
The passage says the arrow struck Ahab, but does not establish that the king of Aram was nowhere in its path.
The passage says the battle raged throughout the day, but does not say Ahab was propped up for the whole time.
The cry tells the men to return, but the passage does not say the fighting was over or that the men were sent home.
